  {"step": 7, "file": "spng.c", "function": "read_data", "line": 291, "var": "ctx->data", "code": "void *buf = spng__realloc(ctx, ctx->data, bytes);", "note": "realloc frees the old ctx->data buffer and allocates a larger one"},

  {"step": 10, "file": "spng.c", "function": "read_chunks_before_idat", "line": 1229, "var": "exif.data", "code": "memcpy(exif.data, data, chunk.length);", "note": "READ from freed memory via dangling pointer 'data' — heap-use-after-free"}
]
EOF
